key_facts: REVIEWED Sat Sep 12 (T+1d to res=2026-09-13 / Sep 25 cutoff; Exa Reuters/Kyiv24/KyivPost/AA/KyivIndependent Sep 11-12 + local Arab News/Straits Times/HT Sep 12; UNCHANGED at Switzerland 0.25, United Arab Emirates 0.23, Turkey 0.20, United States 0.17, Saudi Arabia 0.04; sum=0.89, outside=0.11): On Sat Sep 12 at the YES forum in Kyiv, Presidential Office head Kyrylo Budanov announced Ukraine is preparing for renewed trilateral (US-Russia-Ukraine) talks in October, but explicitly refrained from commenting on the venue. Speaking via videolink at YES, US envoy Jared Kushner said Washington is organizing a direct trilateral meeting and hoped to announce 'next steps' within a couple of weeks. In a Deutsche Welle interview (conducted Fri Sep 11 in Canada, released Sat Sep 12), Zelensky said he would be willing to meet Putin at the Miami G20 summit in December if both were invited (immediately rejected by Kremlin spokesman Peskov: 'impossible... Moscow'), which was a DW hypothetical on a Dec leaders' meeting rather than a Washington proposal for renewed trilateral talks. No new Washington-proposed venue has been publicly identified by Zelensky since his Sep 8 shortlist ('Turkey, the United Arab Emirates, Switzerland, or other countries'). Holding balanced top-5 for res day Sun Sep 13.
